description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractExpression' for representing expression nodes within the Twig templating engine. It extends a generic Node class and provides methods related to expression attributes such as generator status and explicit parentheses.

classes.name: AbstractExpression
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for all expression nodes in Twig, providing common functionality related to expression attributes.

methods.name: isGenerator
methods.description: Checks whether the expression node is marked as a generator based on its attributes.

methods.name: setExplicitParentheses
methods.description: Marks the expression node to be wrapped with parentheses explicitly.

methods.name: hasExplicitParentheses
methods.description: Determines if the expression node is marked to have explicit parentheses.
